scope: Bounded AUTH03 correction of five exact independently confirmed auth/session/backup/password-change findings; no commits, pushes, dependencies, migrations, deployments, CI changes or real funds; Learn owned by root.

findings.change: Lock current account, require unchanged credential revision/provider identity and an unrevoked unexpired signed session, then verify password and atomically disable MFA and consume pending proofs. The local session policy is preserved.
evidence: a reset queued before MFA disable rejects the old credential and preserves MFA
MFA disable rechecks a session revoked while the request waits for its account
legitimate MFA disable invalidates pending proofs without ending the current session

findings.change: Database increment uses current failed_login_attempts and current committed threshold, conditional on the verified credential snapshot. Old password failures cannot penalize a new revision.
evidence: five concurrent wrong passwords count durably and lock the account
a password failure from an obsolete credential does not increment the new credential

findings.change: Auth service binds completions to operation revision plus unchanged refresh-session identity, and MFA additionally binds to exact still-live pending proof. Login/signup/logout advance revision. UI checks service result identity and component lifetime. AuthProvider login and catch compare its existing sessionGeneration.
evidence: pending MFA after logout/new-login cannot restore original account
replaced pending proof and concurrent MFA replay cannot overwrite newer proof/session
late login/logout cannot overwrite or delete newer account
older AuthProvider login success/failure preserves later authenticated React state
MFA UI completion after invalidation/unmount has no session update or navigation

findings.change: Accepted separator-free and lowercase backup input is submitted as generated uppercase XXXX-XXXX.
evidence: separator-free backup codes are normalized to the generated server representation
saved hexadecimal backup codes have a reachable input and are submitted intact

findings.change: Server response exposes reauthenticationRequired true for provider and false for local credentials. Provider success clears old tokens/proof/persisted user and UI clears current React user and routes to sign-in with accurate toast/copy. Stale provider response cannot clear a new login.
evidence: provider password change explicitly requires reauthentication and revokes every session
local password change preserves current session and returns false
client clears only required session, rejects stale account response
modal clears React session before sign-in navigation and explains possible sign-in
